## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5); confirmations: sector breadth ≥7/11 and Financials/Healthcare showing multiple ABOVE TREND names (MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%)).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%). Technology strong on 1W bounce but mixed over 1M: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%). Financials firm: MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%). Energy weak: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%). Real Estate soft: DLR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), ADBE RECOVERY (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%), APD ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: T BELOW TREND (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%), CAT CORRECTION (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%), DLR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%). Weakness concentrated across Utilities and pockets of Industrials/Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present: several large-cap names (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META) show 1W up vs 1M down → MAJOR DIVERGENCE; watch for trend break and avoid assuming broad follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed short-term bounce, longer-term dispersion: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%). Technology 1W +3.19% | 1M -8.16%; watch confirmation given broad RECOVERY signals and several CORRECTION/BELOW TREND names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%). Financials 1W +2.73% | 1M +7.27%; supports the RISK-ON regime but watch pockets of profit-taking (JPM).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthy leadership and confirming flows: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%). Healthcare 1W +4.42% | 1M +11.22% and is a clear sectoral engine for the market.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Healthcare exposure given multiple ABOVE TREND names; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing RECOVERY without 1M confirmation (AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%)). Leadership narrowness and a MAJOR DIVERGENCE argue for selectivity rather than broad risk accumulation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%).  
BEARISH: QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%), LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%), DLR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W +4.42% | 1M +11.22%) and Financials (1W +2.73% | 1M +7.27%) — breadth supportive.  
BEARISH: Utilities (1W -1.24% | 1M +3.46%) and Energy (1W -0.80% | 1M -6.63%) — weakness may persist.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) — watch reclaim of 1M trend for broader Tech confirmation. AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) — need follow-through above this week’s gap to validate RECOVERY. MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) — sustain ABOVE TREND to confirm Financials leadership. QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) — failure to stabilize would signal deeper distribution in semis.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JPM (+90): JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — buyback/dividend headline is bullish but price shows short-term exhaustion → divergence to monitor. QCOM (+55): QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — positive supply deal headlines but price is falling → divergence. TSLA (+55): TSLA (1W: +4.89% | 1M: -7.15%) RECOVERY — upbeat headlines and price action are confirming accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LRCX (-50): LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — negative headlines align with price weakness, confirming risk. ADBE (-45): ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY — analyst caution but strong 1W bounce creates divergence; watch for distribution. ORCL and ABBV appear in the news-sentiment list but lack complete dual-timeframe detail here; monitor if trends deteriorate.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech dominance in the Top 5. MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large-cap Tech (multiple RECOVERY cases) vs bearish news in semis (QCOM, LRCX) and a narrow leadership profile — monitor news-confirmation (JPM buyback) and follow-through before adding beta.
